<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2018 Gaza border protests#20 July|2018 Gaza border protests]]
**An Israeli soldier is killed by a Palestinian sniper and four [[Izz ad-Din al-Qassam Brigades|Hamas military wing]] members die in a gunfight. Three rockets are fired into Israeli communities near Gaza, where two are intercepted by the [[Iron Dome]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/07/20/world/middleeast/israel-gaza-violence.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/07/20/middleeast/israel-launches-attack-in-gaza/index.html (CNN)]

;Law and crime
*[[Impeachment of Park Geun-hye]]
**Former [[South Korea]]n [[President of South Korea|President]] [[Park Geun-hye]] is sentenced to an additional eight years for abusing state funds and violating election laws. [https://www.cbc.ca/amp/1.4754622 (CBC)]
*A man stabs another on a bus in [[Lübeck]], [[Germany]], prompting an evacuation. Police find a smoldering non-explosive backpack aboard. Between eight and thirteen other people are wounded, five by a knife, and the local suspect is arrested. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-44904183 (BBC)] [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/german-bus-attack-injuries-1.4754803 (CBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2017–18 Iranian protests]]
**In the [[Sa'dabad Complex]] of [[Tehran]], a group of [[Iran]]ian girls severely burned in a 2012 school fire protest unequal [[diyah]] by the government toward their medical bills, which some say is an inalienable right. Their lawyer says Iran's policy of paying half diyah to women is "unfair and discriminatory". [http://www.payvand.com/news/18/jul/1071.html (''PayvAnd'')]
*[[People's Party (Spain) leadership election, 2018]]
**The XIX Congress of the [[People's Party (Spain)|People's Party]] begins, which will elect the new party leader and successor of former [[Spain|Spanish]] [[Prime Minister of Spain|Prime Minister]] [[Mariano Rajoy]]. The candidates are former [[Deputy Prime Minister of Spain|Deputy Prime Minister]] [[Soraya Sáenz de Santamaría]] and the party's Deputy Secretary of Communication [[Pablo Casado]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-spain-politics/at-crossroads-spains-ousted-conservatives-pick-new-leader-idUSKBN1KA25I (Reuters)]
